excerpt: British Airways doesn't charge a separate golf clubs fee like other airlines — whether it's free depends on your fare and baggage allowance. Here's how to work out which applies to you.

content.text: British Airways handles golf clubs quite differently from the low-cost carriers flying into Faro. There's no separate "sports equipment" fee to work out — your clubs are simply treated as one of your checked bags. Whether that ends up costing you anything at all depends entirely on your fare type and what else you're checking in, so it's worth understanding before you assume it's either free or expensive.
How British Airways treats golf clubs

A golf bag counts as a **standard checked bag**, not a separate paid category. If it's packed in a proper golf bag or hard case and comes in under the weight limit, it simply uses up one of the checked bags your fare already includes — the same as a suitcase would. That's a genuinely different approach to Ryanair, easyJet or Jet2, all of which charge a dedicated sports equipment fee regardless of what else you're carrying.
When it's free

It comes down to your fare. **Basic fares** (British Airways' cheapest tier) don't include a checked bag at all, so anything you check in — golf clubs included — is extra. **Standard fares and above** typically include at least one checked bag up to **23kg**, and if your golf bag is packed under that weight and it's the only hold item you're bringing, it can travel completely free, using up that included allowance. Bring a separate suitcase too, though, and the golf bag becomes your second piece — which is where the fees below kick in.
When you'll pay, and roughly how much

If you're on a Basic fare, or your golf bag is an additional item beyond what your fare already includes, it's charged at British Airways' standard **extra checked bag** rate. That price isn't fixed — BA prices it by route and demand, and figures reported for European short-haul routes vary fairly widely, roughly **£25–£60+ each way**. Rather than rely on a single number, use British Airways' online baggage calculator for the actual Faro route when you book — it's also always cheaper to add it in **Manage My Booking** ahead of time than to pay at the airport.
Size limits and checking it in

Golf bags are classed as **out-of-gauge** baggage — larger than a normal suitcase — up to roughly **190 x 75 x 65cm**. Because of that, you can't just drop it at a standard bag-drop desk; British Airways asks you to take it to the dedicated oversize/out-of-gauge baggage point at the airport, and to allow at least **2 hours before departure** for a short-haul flight like one to Faro. Turning up at the last minute with an oversize item is the easiest way to have a stressful start to a golf trip.
Free doesn't always mean easiest

Even when the fee works out to nothing, there's still a golf bag to haul to a separate oversize desk, load onto a trolley, and hope arrives in one piece. Some golfers flying British Airways decide that's still more hassle than it's worth for a short trip, and rent instead. Two operators work directly out of **Faro Airport (FAO)**: one with a desk in the arrivals hall, another at a counter in the departures terminal. Either way, you can collect a set the moment you land, or have one waiting at your hotel or first course, with nothing to check in at all.

Rental terms, delivery areas and daily rates differ between operators, so it's worth comparing before you decide — our [directory of club rental shops](/shops) covers every option across the Algarve, not just the two based at the airport.
Bottom line

British Airways is the one airline on this list where flying with your own clubs can genuinely cost nothing extra — check your fare's baggage allowance before assuming otherwise. But between the fare-type rules, route-based pricing if you don't qualify, and the out-of-gauge drop-off, it takes more homework than the flat per-bag fee other airlines charge. If that's more admin than you want for a short trip, renting at Faro Airport removes the question entirely.

excerpt: When Algarve twilight green fees start, what they cost, where the saving is biggest, and whether there's enough daylight to finish 18 holes in each month.

content.text: Twilight golf means booking a late tee time for a cheaper green fee. In the Algarve, twilight rates start between about **1pm and 4pm**, depending on the course and the time of year, and they can cost less than half the standard price: **€35 at Santo António**, **€50 at Alto Golf** and **€60 at Vila Sol**, against €140 or more for a standard round at Vila Sol. The catch is daylight. From **April to September** you have time for 18 holes. From **November to February** the sun sets between about 5.15pm and 6.15pm, and a tee time much after 1pm won't get you round 18 holes before dark.
When does twilight start, and what does it cost?

These are examples from each club's official price list or its own online booking, not a full list of every course with a twilight rate. Some clubs change the start time through the year, others keep one time all year.

content.note: Sources: Pestana Golf price list (checked 18 November 2026); Santo António 2026 rates; Benamor internet rates; Vale do Lobo Twilight & Sunset schedule; online booking at Espiche, Salgados, Vale do Lobo and Monte Rei, sampled October and November 2026. Standard round = lowest visitor price for 18 holes across the year. Prices change, and clubs that sell online adjust them day by day.
rows: **€59** (December, January and June to August only)
1pm in winter, 3pm to 3.30pm the rest of the year
content.caption: Twilight green fees for 18 holes

content.text: Pestana lists a single twilight time and price for each of its courses, with no seasonal change. Its twilight buggy costs €40. At Vale do Lobo the twilight start moves through the year: **1pm from mid-November to January**, 1.30pm in February, 2pm in March, 3.30pm from the end of March to 20 May, 3pm from late May to mid-September, 3.30pm again until late October and 2pm until mid-November. Vale do Lobo also sells a later **Sunset** rate, from 3pm in winter, rising to 5pm from April to late October, at the same price as twilight.
Penina's last published visitor price list, for 2024/25, had a twilight green fee after 2.30pm. The club hasn't published a newer one, so ask Penina for the current rate.
Can you finish 18 holes?

Vale do Lobo, for example, asks golfers to play 18 holes in **4 hours 30 minutes or less**. Counting back 4 hours 30 minutes from last light (the end of civil twilight, about half an hour after sunset) gives the latest tee time that still lets you finish a full round:

content.note: Calculated for Vilamoura on the 15th of each month, Portugal time. The clocks go forward on the last Sunday of March and back on the last Sunday of October, so light ends about an hour earlier in late October than in mid-October. The west and east of the Algarve differ by only a few minutes.
content.caption: Daylight for a twilight round, central Algarve (mid-month)

content.text: **April to September:** easy. Twilight usually starts between 3pm and 4pm and there is light until 8pm or later, enough for a full round at a normal pace.
**March and October:** usually fine if you take one of the first twilight tee times. Watch the last week of October, when the clocks go back and last light comes about an hour earlier.

**November to February:** be careful. Last light is around 5.45–6.40pm, so you need to tee off by about 1.15pm in December and 2pm in February. At Vale do Lobo, where twilight starts at 1pm in midwinter, the first slot leaves just enough light for 18 holes at a steady pace. With a 1.30pm start, as at Santo António and Pestana Ferragudo, you have about four and a quarter hours in December, so you'll need to play quickly. A 3.30pm twilight tee time in winter leaves about two and a half hours of light: enough for nine holes or a few more, not a full round. If that is all you want, it is still cheap golf, but book it knowing you won't finish.
Where the saving is biggest

At Pestana's courses the twilight price stays the same all year while the standard rate rises in spring and autumn, so twilight saves most in **March, April and October**, Pestana's premium months. At Vila Sol, for example, a twilight round is €60 against €215 for a standard round in those months. In December or January the gap is smaller: Alto Golf is €75 for a standard round and €50 at twilight.

At clubs with dynamic pricing the saving follows the season too. On the dates we checked, Salgados charged €47 at twilight against €78 for a standard round in January, July and August, and €99 against €139 in spring and autumn. Monte Rei is the exception: its twilight round saved €48–€72 in spring and summer, but in November the twilight rate was €5 more than the standard one. Benamor's afternoon rate only applies in its low season and saves €7.
Tips for booking a twilight tee time

**Check the start time when you book.** Twilight times change through the year at many clubs, and the price list doesn't always say so. The booking engine only shows the twilight price from the right time onwards.
**Take the first twilight slot in winter.** In December, every half hour later is a few holes you may not finish.
**Consider a buggy.** On a hilly course a buggy helps you keep up and finish before dark. Pestana's twilight buggy is €40, cheaper than its standard €55.
**Use it on the day you arrive.** A twilight round on the afternoon you land turns a two-round weekend into three. See our [golf weekend guide](/guide/golf-weekend-in-the-algarve).

**Not every club sells twilight online.** On the dates we checked, the Vilamoura courses run by Dom Pedro, the Quinta do Lago courses, Palmares and Boavista showed no twilight rate in their own online booking. Some may still offer late-afternoon prices by phone or at the desk, so ask. For more ways to save, see [the cheapest golf courses in the Algarve](/guide/the-cheapest-golf-courses-in-the-algarve) and [how to book tee times](/guide/how-to-book-tee-times-in-the-algarve).
Want to play after dark instead? See [night golf in the Algarve](/guide/night-golf-in-the-algarve).
Frequently asked questions
What time does twilight golf start in the Algarve?

Between about 1pm and 4pm, depending on the course and the season. In winter some clubs start twilight at 1pm or 1.30pm; in summer it is usually 3pm to 4pm. Pestana's courses keep the same time all year: 1.30pm at Ferragudo, 3pm at Alto Golf and 3.30pm at Gramacho, Vale da Pinta, Silves and Vila Sol.
Can I play 18 holes on a twilight round in winter?

Only with an early twilight tee time. In December last light is around 5.45pm, so you need to start by about 1.15pm to play 18 holes in four and a half hours. From April to September there is plenty of light for a full round.
Where is the cheapest twilight golf in the Algarve?

Among the courses we checked, Santo António near Salema at €35, then Alto Golf at €50 and Pestana's Gramacho, Vale da Pinta and Silves courses at €55. Salgados and Espiche can be cheaper on some dates, as their online prices change with the season.

excerpt: The cheapest golf in and near Albufeira, from 9-hole rounds to full courses with a buggy included, with drive times and official 2026/27 prices.

content.text: Looking for the **cheapest golf near Albufeira**? You don't have to go far. Albufeira has two short 9-hole courses, and a full 18-hole course 17 minutes from the old town starts at **€78**. This guide compares green fees at every course within about half an hour, and shows which one is cheapest depending on whether you want nine holes, eighteen, or a buggy included.

Prices are the lowest visitor green fee for one round, from each club's official price list or its own online booking for the 2026/27 season, checked in October 2026. Drive times are from Albufeira old town, without traffic. This isn't a complete list, and prices change, so always check when you book.
Green fees near Albufeira compared

content.text: The cheapest 18-hole round: Salgados

[Salgados](/courses/salgados), behind Praia da Galé, is the cheapest full course near Albufeira. It costs **€78** in January, July and August, €102 in February, March and June, and up to €139 in spring and autumn. Its twilight rate is cheaper still: **€47** in those same three months.
It's also flat, and Where2Golf says players generally walk it, so you can skip the €50 buggy if you're happy on foot. The handicap limit is 28 for men and 36 for ladies.
The cheapest round with a buggy: Amendoeira

If you want a buggy, [Amendoeira](/courses/amendoeira-faldo) near Silves can work out cheaper than Salgados. Its online green fee of **€100** in December and January includes a buggy if one is available. In January, a round at Salgados plus its €50 buggy comes to €128 for one player. From June to August, Amendoeira costs €109 with the buggy, against €128 at Salgados with a buggy in July and August. Both of Amendoeira's courses, the Faldo and the O'Connor, have the same rates.
The cheapest short rounds

**[Balaia](/courses/balaia)** is a 9-hole par-3 course at Balaia Golf Village, 13 minutes from the old town. Its 2025/26 price list shows a **€50 day fee**. The resort asks for a handicap but doesn't publish a limit.

**[Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs)** sits on the cliffs above Praia da Falésia, 18 minutes away. Nine holes cost **€57** for most of the year and €76 in February to May and October. Players without a handicap can play from the red tees, which makes it the easiest place near Albufeira to start. Our [Balaia vs Pine Cliffs](/guide/balaia-vs-pine-cliffs-which-quick-round-near-albufeira-should-you-play) guide compares the two.
Cheapest golf near Albufeira for beginners

Start at Pine Cliffs if you don't have a handicap yet. Once you do, [Vilamoura Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium), 24 minutes away, is a forgiving 18-hole course from €88, and Salgados is a flat, walkable option from €78. See [the best Algarve golf courses for beginners](/guide/the-10-best-algarve-golf-courses-for-beginners) for more.
Frequently asked questions
What is the cheapest golf course near Albufeira?
For a full 18 holes, Salgados, from €78 in January, July and August, or €47 at twilight. For a short round, Balaia's €50 day fee or nine holes at Pine Cliffs from €57.
Can you play golf in Albufeira without a handicap?
Yes, at Pine Cliffs, from the red tees. Balaia and Salgados both ask for a handicap.
When is golf cheapest near Albufeira?

January, July and August at Salgados, and December and January at Amendoeira. Spring and autumn are the most expensive months at most courses. Our [Algarve golf season guide](/guide/algarve-golf-season-best-time-to-play-golf) explains why.

For all the courses on a map, see [Albufeira golf courses](/albufeira/golf-courses). Planning the whole trip? excerpt: Vilamoura's cheapest green fees course by course, the free-buggy offer at Laguna, and cheaper rounds within half an hour, from official prices.

content.text: Vilamoura is one of the Algarve's best-known golf resorts, but it isn't one of the cheapest places to play. The lowest green fee in Vilamoura itself is **€88**, and the famous Old Course starts at €215. This guide shows the **cheapest golf in Vilamoura** course by course, when to go for the lowest prices, and the cheaper rounds a short drive away.

Prices are the lowest visitor green fee for one round, taken from each club's official price list or its own online booking for the 2026/27 season and checked in October 2026. Drive times are from Vilamoura marina, without traffic. This isn't a complete list of every option, and prices change, so always check when you book.
Vilamoura green fees compared

Five courses in Vilamoura take visitors: the four run by Vilamoura Golf (Laguna, Millennium, Pinhal and the Old Course) and Pestana's Vila Sol. Vilamoura Golf's fifth course, the Els Club, is a private members' club and can't be booked by visitors.

content.text: [Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna) and [Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium) are the cheapest courses in Vilamoura. Both cost €97 in July and August, and drop to €88 in late autumn: in November at Laguna and in December at Millennium. The dearest months are February to May, at €132 to €136, and Laguna is also €136 in January.
Laguna's free buggy offer

Vilamoura Golf doesn't publish a buggy hire price, so a free buggy makes a real difference. Its **Laguna on Wheels** offer gives a complimentary shared buggy on every round at Laguna for new bookings made by 31 December 2026, for play from 19 October 2026 to 31 December 2027. It isn't valid from 1 April to 31 May or from 16 September to 18 October 2027. That makes Laguna the cheapest way we found to play a full round in Vilamoura with a buggy.
Vila Sol: twilight and two-player deals

[Vila Sol](/courses/vila-sol) starts at €140, but it has two ways to pay less. Its twilight rate is **€60** from 3:30pm all year, with a twilight buggy at €40. And Pestana's summer special for two players sharing a buggy costs €208 from June to August, which is **€104 each** with the buggy included, or €300 for two from 16 to 30 May and in September. See our guide to [best value golf in the Algarve](/guide/best-value-golf-in-the-algarve) for the full Pestana deal.
Cheaper golf near Vilamoura
If you're happy to drive a little, these courses cost less than anything in Vilamoura itself:

content.text: [Pine Cliffs](/courses/pine-cliffs) is a 9-hole clifftop course above Praia da Falésia, from €57 for nine holes, and players without a handicap can play from the red tees. [Balaia](/courses/balaia) is a 9-hole par-3 course with a €50 day fee; it asks for a handicap but doesn't publish a limit.

For a full 18 holes, [Vale do Lobo](/courses/vale-do-lobo-ocean)'s Sunset rate starts at **€76** in January, February, November and December, and the club includes a shared buggy for full-paying adults on that rate. That's cheaper than a standard round at any course in Vilamoura. Further west, [Salgados](/courses/salgados) costs from €78, with twilight rounds from €47, but it's about 43 minutes from Vilamoura by car.
The cheapest Vilamoura course for beginners

[Millennium](/courses/vilamoura-millennium) is the one we'd suggest for newer golfers: it has wide fairways, it's described as flat, and it has the lowest official slope rating of Vilamoura Golf's four courses (130 from the back tees, against 135 to 140 for the others). [Laguna](/courses/vilamoura-laguna) costs the same, but its water carries make it harder for a beginner.

All the Vilamoura courses ask for a handicap of 28 for men and 36 for ladies. If you don't have one yet, Pine Cliffs is the nearest course where you can play without a handicap. Our guides to [the best Algarve courses for beginners](/guide/the-10-best-algarve-golf-courses-for-beginners) and [handicap rules in the Algarve](/guide/do-you-need-a-handicap-to-play-golf-in-the-algarve) have more.
How to pay less for golf in Vilamoura

**Pick your month.** July and August cost €97 at both Laguna and Millennium, and the lowest prices come in November at Laguna and December at Millennium (€88). The dearest months are March to May at the Old Course and Pinhal, and February to May at Laguna and Millennium.
**Choose Laguna if you want a buggy.** The Laguna on Wheels offer is the clearest saving in Vilamoura while it runs.
**Play late or as a pair at Vila Sol.** Its €60 twilight rate and the two-player summer deal both cut the price well below its standard green fee.
Frequently asked questions
What is the cheapest golf course in Vilamoura?
Laguna and Millennium, both from €88: in November at Laguna and in December at Millennium. In summer, both cost €97.
Is golf in Vilamoura expensive?

Compared with the rest of the Algarve, yes. The cheapest 18-hole round in Vilamoura is €88, while the cheapest in the Algarve start at €57 to €67, mainly in the far west and east. See [the cheapest golf courses in the Algarve](/guide/the-cheapest-golf-courses-in-the-algarve) for the full list, and [how much a golf trip to Vilamoura costs](/guide/how-much-does-a-golf-trip-to-vilamoura-cost) for a whole-trip budget.
Is there cheap golf near Vilamoura without a handicap?
Pine Cliffs, 25 minutes away, lets players without a handicap play from the red tees, with nine holes from €57.

For every course, price and handicap rule side by side, see [Vilamoura golf courses](/vilamoura/golf-courses) on our map. If you're still choosing where to stay, our guide to [golf hotels near Vilamoura](/guide/golf-hotels-near-vilamoura) can help.
